definitions.explanation: An emergency vehicle equipped to transport sick or injured people to a hospital and provide medical care during transport.

examples.japanese: {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んで→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイレン→サイレン：26994_sairen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear an ambulance siren.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather was taken to the hospital by ambulance.

notes:
{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ} is composed of ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧ (emergency, first aid) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle). It refers specifically to an ambulance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call an ambulance
- {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれる→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to be transported by ambulance
- {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: an ambulance arrives
- {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手配|てはい}→手配：07604_tehai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to arrange an ambulance

CULTURAL NOTE:
Dial 119 for ambulance and fire emergencies. Ambulance service is free in Japan, though this has led to debates about misuse for non-emergencies.

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん}→救急隊員：22769_kyuukyuutaiin⟧: paramedic
- ⟦{救急病院|きゅうきゅうびょういん}→救急病院：28802_kyuukyuubyouin⟧: emergency hospital
- ⟦{消防車|しょうぼうしゃ}→消防車：05078_shoubousha⟧: fire truck (also reached via 119)
